sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Refrigerated Logistics Warehousing for Perishable Pharmaceuticals

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law with commercial and maritime hybrid influences

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 23 of 2015 (AML/CFT) as amended by Law 70 of 2019; Executive Decree 394 of 2015; Law 25 of 1995 (Private Interest Foundations); and the beneficial ownership registration regulations of the Registro Público and the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of Founder's certified identification document (passport or national identity card)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization if the origin is not a Hague Convention state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foundation Charter and By-laws (Escritura Pública) executed before a Panamanian Notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille not required; domestic notarial deed to be filed with the Registro Público

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or apostilled certificate of good standing or incorporation of the foreign corporate founder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the foreign founder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial ownership declaration and control structure statement (Declaración de Beneficiario Final)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if executed abroad; otherwise notarized in Panama

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of the Founder, Beneficiaries, Foundation Council and Protector against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated sanctions, and Panama's domestic AML/CFT lists; enhanced due diligence is required for any person qualifying as a Politically Exposed Person; screening must be performed in all relevant languages and transliterated name variants before the foundation deed is granted.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Portal Virtual / Sede Electrónica (SRPOnline): https://www.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Latin (Roman) characters; Spanish and other Latin-script languages are accepted; non-Latin scripts are transliterated phonetically. A Private Interest Foundation must include the word 'Foundation' or 'Fundación' in its name and must not be confusingly similar to any existing registered entity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within five (5) business days of the rejection notification, the applicant may file a written reconsideration appeal (Recurso de Reconsideración) before the Dirección General del Registro Público de Panamá, attaching a revised name search certificate. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file a second administrative appeal before the Board of Directors of the Registro Público, or ultimately pursue judicial review before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso Administrativo of the Corte Suprema de Justicia. The original name reservation may be extended once for a further 30 days upon payment of the applicable renewal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible solely for the PIF's registered-office and registered-agent legal address. For the cold-storage operating subsidiary, a physical refrigerated warehouse within the relevant operational jurisdiction is mandatory; a virtual address cannot satisfy the statutory licensing and commercial-substance requirements of the refrigerated logistics industry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% per year for an ordinary low-risk, non-PEP Beneficiary; increases to 40% where the PIF holds physical real assets, receives high-risk counterparties, or operates in a sector subject to municipal health and safety inspections.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and reservation certificate
Notarization of the Foundation Charter (Escritura Pública)
Public Registry filing and registration of the Foundation
Hague Apostille for foreign founder documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panama Ministry of Foreign Affairs or competent apostille authority in the origin country

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Appointment and first-year registered agent service for the PIF

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros / Registro Público

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence, AML/CFT screening, and constitutive contract drafting
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for private client and corporate compliance work

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 25 de 12 de junio de 1995 (Régimen Jurídico de las Fundaciones de Interés Privado), as amended by Ley No. 13 de 27 de enero de 2017; implementing regulation Decreto Ejecutivo No. 260 de 2020; applicable sections: Arts. 1-25 (creation, patrimony, foundation council, resident agent, registration, dissolution).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Fundaciones de Interés Privado / Mercantile Section, Belisario Porras, Parque Lefevre, Panama City, Republic of Panama.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acta de Fundación (Foundation Charter) and Reglamento (Foundation Regulations), executed before a Panamanian notary and inscribed at the Registro Público de Panamá; the Registry issues a Certificado de Inscripción as the constitutive document.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under Ley 25 de 1995, the Foundation Charter must state an initial patrimony (endowment) of no less than USD 10,000 (or the equivalent in balboas). The endowment may be recorded as a contribution promise and must be traceable in the foundation's accounting records. There is no statutory escrow account requirement in Panama; however, licensed Panamanian banks may require deposit of the stated endowment as part of AML/KYC due diligence.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION No. 1 OF THE FOUNDATION COUNCIL OF [●] PRIVATE INTEREST FOUNDATION. The undersigned members of the Foundation Council of the [●] Private Interest Foundation, acting jointly: WHEREAS the Foundation was duly constituted and registered under Law 25 of 1995; NOW THEREFORE, the following resolutions are unanimously adopted: 1. That the initial patrimony of US$10,000.00 contributed by the Founder, as stated in the Foundation Charter, is hereby subscribed, accepted, and receipted. 2. That the registered office of the Foundation is established at [●], Panama City, Republic of Panama. 3. That [●] is appointed President, [●] Secretary, and [●] Treasurer of the Foundation Council, each with full powers under the Charter. Passed unanimously this [●] day of [●], 20[●].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Foundation Charter and Regulations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Notary of the Republic of Panama (Notaría Pública), Panama City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct counsel to prepare the Acta de Fundación and Reglamento in compliance with Ley 25 de 1995. The Founder executes the documents before a Panamanian notary to authenticate signatures. If real property is contributed to the foundation, the charter must be elevated to a public deed (escritura pública). The notarial authentication certificate is appended for subsequent Registry filing.
required_dossiers: Passport or valid government-issued ID of the Founder
Draft Acta de Fundación (Foundation Charter)
Draft Reglamento (Foundation Regulations)
Registered Agent acceptance letter
Statement of initial endowment source (AML risk assessment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects formal defects, counsel amends the instruments and the Founder re-executes before the same notary; no registry deficiency arises at this pre-filing stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission and Inscription of the Foundation Charter at the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Fundaciones de Interés Privado (Mercantile Section), single-window filing and online payment portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the originally executed Foundation Charter and Regulations together with proof of payment of official state fees, requesting inscription of the foundation. The Registry assigns a mercantile folio, verifies the substantive requirements of Ley 25 de 1995, and records the foundation. Fee payment is made at the National Bank of Panama or through the Registry's online payment portal.
required_dossiers: Original notarized Acta de Fundación and Reglamento
Official filing fee receipt (approximately USD 350)
Registered Agent appointment form
Power of attorney, if filed through a representative
Legal identification copy of the Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a nota de defectos, file a notarized addendum (adenda) curing the defect within 10 working days. A refusal may be appealed to the Junta Directiva del Registro Público and subsequently challenged before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo de la Corte Suprema de Justicia.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certified Inscription and Foundation Existence Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Certification Office / Registry Customer Service)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the inscription is recorded, request certified copies (copia autenticada) of the inscribed Foundation Charter and a certificate of no deficiencies. The recorded inscription date is the constitutive date of the foundation's separate legal personality. Certified copies are used for banking, tax registration, and subsequent licensing.
required_dossiers: Registry filing or control number
Receipt of registration fees
Written request for certified copies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If certification is delayed, escalate to the Registry's customer service office; any factual data correction requires submission of a formal feasibility note and an amended notarized addendum.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Resident Agent Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá and licensed Resident Agent (Panamanian law firm or corporate services provider)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain at all times a registered office in Panama and a licensed Resident Agent. The Resident Agent acceptance letter and registered office address are lodged with the Registry as part of the foundation file. The Resident Agent retains custody of records and receives service of process. Any change of Resident Agent must be filed with the Registry within 30 days.
required_dossiers: Notarized Resident Agent acceptance letter
Lease or title evidence of registered office in Panama
Foundation Council resolution ratifying the Resident Agent
Resident Agent license details (identification and Aviso de Operación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Resident Agent acceptance is defective, submit a corrected notarized acceptance. Failure to maintain a Resident Agent triggers a Registry warning and is cured by appointing a replacement agent and filing the corresponding form.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification (RUC), Municipal Aviso de Operación and Fiscal Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Municipality of Panama — Dirección de Rentas Municipales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit to the DGI the application for registration in the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) using the certified Foundation Charter. Simultaneously file the Aviso de Operación and obtain the municipal patent (patente municipal) at the Municipality where the registered office is located. The RUC is issued online; the municipal notice is issued after payment and land-use verification. This fiscal enrollment is the precondition for formal payroll, invoicing, and operating licenses.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered Foundation Charter
Registered Agent identification (cédula or passport)
DGI RUC application form
Municipal Aviso de Operación application form
Lease contract of the registered office
Fiscal compliance declaration for territorial taxation enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is queried due to the non-resident status of the Founder or tax domicile issues, submit a written brief clarifying the foundation's tax domicile and business scope. Municipal license refusals may be cured by completing the land-use certification from the Dirección de Ingeniería Municipal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foundation Council Organization, Officer Post-Filing and Bank Mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (post-filing of officers); Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (licensed banking entities)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the inaugural Foundation Council session to adopt the formal First Board Resolution, appoint officers, and define bank signatories. If the officers are not named in the Foundation Charter, file a supplemental resolution with the Registry. The certified formation bundle is presented to a licensed Panamanian bank to open the foundation's corporate account. Thereafter, the foundation may commence the cold-storage industrial licensing process.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution signed by all Foundation Council members
Passport or ID copies of appointed officers
Certified foundation existence certificate
Bank account application package and AML source-of-funds documentation
Utility bill verifying the registered office (KYC requirement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, supply organizational charts and personal resumes of the officers. Any Registry query about officer appointments is cured by an amending resolution and filing of a supplementary addendum.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — Dirección General de Empresas y Patentes, jointly with Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) — Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas for pharmaceutical cold-storage authorization, and the Municipality of Panama — Dirección de Rentas Municipales for the Aviso de Operación and patente municipal.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación Industrial/Comercial y Patente Municipal (Municipio de Panamá); Licencia Sanitaria de Funcionamiento para Depósito de Productos Farmacéuticos Termolábiles (MINSA); Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Almacenamiento/Distribución for temperature-controlled pharmaceutical logistics.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría II — Informe Ambiental Categoría II (Diagnóstico Ambiental de Impacto Ambiental, DAIA) required for refrigerated warehouses using synthetic refrigerant systems, backup diesel generators, or discharging wastewater outside the municipal sewer system. Categoría I (Registro Ambiental / Aviso de Inscripción) applies to small standalone facilities with full municipal sewer connection and no hazardous refrigerant blow-down.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits under Decreto Ejecutivo No. 10 de 21 de enero de 1999: pH 6-9, BOD5 ≤ 150 mg/L, TSS ≤ 150 mg/L, oil and grease ≤ 50 mg/L. Refrigerant handling must comply with Montreal Protocol obligations: zero discharge of CFC/HCFC/HFC refrigerants, annual leak-testing, and recovery logbooks. Generators and boilers must meet applicable atmospheric emission rules for particulate matter and NOx; volatile organic compound (VOC) controls required at cold-storage dock areas. Hazardous and inert waste must be manifested and transported only through MiAMBIENTE-authorized handlers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Certificado de Inspección de Seguridad Contra Incendios) issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural load and mechanical safety inspection by the Dirección de Ingeniería Municipal of the Municipality of Panama, including floor-load rating of refrigeration decks; occupational health clearance (Registro de Salud Ocupacional) from the Ministerio de Salud and MITRADEL covering thermal stress, entry protocols for refrigerated atmospheres, personal protective equipment, and emergency evacuation drills.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; portal: DGI Sede Electrónica (https://dgi.mef.gob.pa)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Private Interest Foundation (PIF) must be duly established through the Public Registry with a registered foundation deed. For any taxable commercial activity, the PIF must then obtain a Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) from DGI by filing the prescribed application, submitting the foundation charter, resident agent acceptance, and appointment of the foundation council. Thereafter, registration for ITBMS (indirect tax) and, if applicable, employer registration with the Social Security Fund (CSS) must be completed before operations commence. A passive PIF with no Panama-source income may hold assets without obtaining a RUC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not operate a check-the-box or US-style pass-through election. PIFs are not eligible for transparent tax treatment; only Panama-source income is subject to corporate income tax. A PIF may elect to conduct commercial activity through a separate taxable entity if permitted by its charter, but no hybrid mismatch deduction election is available under Panamanian tax law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS - Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (Value-Added Tax on goods and services)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Legal entities: mandatory registration upon commencement of taxable activities with no monetary threshold. Individuals: optional small taxpayer regime for annual gross turnover up to B/. 36,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All registered taxpayers are required to issue DGI-authorized electronic invoices using the Panamanian Facturación Electrónica platform. Each invoice must bear a unique Código Único de Identificación (CUI), a digital signature, and be transmitted to the DGI tax clearance server in near real-time; failure to obtain fiscal clearance invalidates the invoice for ITBMS input credit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods that physically leave Panama under a valid customs export procedure provided the exporter is registered, title passes to a foreign buyer, and the export sale is supported by a legally issued commercial invoice. Services are zero-rated when performed, delivered, or effectively used outside Panama for a non-resident recipient. Exporters must present the prescribed documentation to the DGI and the National Customs Authority (ANA) to evidence the exit of goods and receipt of foreign proceeds.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única de Aduana - DUA)
Inward Remittance Certificate / Bank Wire Confirmation (SWIFT MT103)
Container Seal Number and Cold-Chain Monitoring Report (for temperature-controlled goods)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and ANA jointly audit export zero-rating claims. Missing, inconsistent, or fraudulent documentation triggers immediate ITBMS clawback at 7%, plus monthly interest and surcharges. Penalties include fines of 300% to 500% of the omitted tax, suspension or cancellation of the RUC and exporter registry status, and criminal liability for tax evasion and customs fraud. Retrospective adjustments may be levied for up to the full statute-of-limitations period under Panamanian law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) — the sole banking and financial regulatory authority; no standalone central bank exists, and the US dollar is legal tender with the Balboa as a purely notional 1:1 fractional unit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama maintains full de jure and de facto convertibility on both current and capital accounts. There are no foreign exchange surrender requirements, no exchange-rate controls, and no approval gates for profit, dividend, interest, or capital repatriation. The SBP imposes mandatory reporting under AML/CFT Law 23 of 2015, requiring beneficiary disclosure and documentary substantiation of the underlying economic transaction for any remittance above bank-specific thresholds, and financial institutions exercise enhanced due diligence on high-risk income streams from offshore jurisdictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no statutory surrender, conversion, or mandatory warehousing of export proceeds. Exporters are free to retain, deploy, or remit USD funds abroad; no percentage conversion to local currency is required. Service providers and cold-storage operators must file statistical export declarations with the Panama Customs Authority for tracking purposes, and banking counterparties will expect export contracts, commercial invoices, and customs concurrent declarations when receiving large trade settlements.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility. Panamanian law permits fintech payment service providers only if they hold a SBP-issued license; non-licensed offshore digital EMIs cannot execute onshore clearing or act as treasury accounts. An unlicensed EMI may be used as a supplementary disbursement channel, but all settlement must be bridged through a licensed Panamanian bank or a correspondent account, and the SBP will regard offshore EMI flows as high-money-laundering-risk triggers unless full KYC, source-of-funds, and transaction-chain documentation is produced contemporaneously.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical interview is generally mandatory for directors, foundation guardians, and authorised signatories during the final underwriting process, although video-assisted KYC is increasingly accepted for re-verification. A registered resident agent in Panama must appear in person for foundation certification. Remote opening is possible only where the bank's compliance committee approves a surrogate interview by a notary public or a Panamanian embassy official, and the foundation must provide a certified copy of the deed, foundation council minutes, beneficial-ownership declaration, and apostilled identification for every council member.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through entity with unclear beneficial ownership or a foundation council lacking local substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The original foundation deed, internal regulations, certificate of existence from the Public Registry, a legal opinion from Panamanian counsel identifying the underlying beneficial owner, and a duly completed SBP beneficial-ownership form with precise percentage attribution; the resident agent must sign a representation letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity funds or abnormal transaction volumes disproportionate to the cold-storage business's declared revenue
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements for the prior two years, a rolling 12-month bank statement from the originator, commercial contracts with storage clients, cargo manifests, customs declarations, and a cash-flow forecast for the coming fiscal year.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border remittances to tax-haven or hard-to-trace jurisdictions (e.g., shell suppliers, third-party settlement)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Final supplier invoices, bills of lading, purchase orders, inspection certificates, and a transactional rationale narrative; the account must also have a prior pattern of legitimate trade, matched against the declared ISIC 5210 refrigerated-logistics activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections should be routed through an MT103 SWIFT with a clearly stated purpose code reflecting 'Capital Contribution to Private Interest Foundation' or 'Equity Injection for Refrigerated Logistics Assets'; include the foundation's name, account number, beneficiary bank, SBP institution code, and the resident agent's reference. The sending bank must retain funds-transfer records and the Panamanian bank requires the underlying capital contribution agreement in English or Spanish, the foundation deed, proof of source of funds, and a signed compliance declaration. For amounts exceeding $10,000, the bank is obligated to report under the SBP's financial-intelligence regime; larger amounts should be split into documented, manifestly genuine capital tranches to avoid AML structuring alerts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for refrigeration equipment, energy equipment, and perishable-pharmaceutical supplies should be executed by SWIFT MT103 directly to the beneficiary supplier's account, or through an irrevocable confirmed documentary letter of credit (UCP600) where transport and invoice certainty is required. USD clearing should be directed via the bank's New York correspondent using CHIPS or Fedwire, using the beneficiary bank's ABA/RIB and SWIFT BIC. For recurring payroll and domestic logistics payments, use ACH direct debits via the Panamanian Automated Clearing House. Each outbound disbursement must carry a transaction narrative consistent with the declared ISIC 5210 activity and the bank's instructed purpose code.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/EUR spot and forward contracts with SBP-authorized banks (no balance-sheet exposure in USD base currency)
USD/GBP FX forwards designed to hedge equipment purchases from UK suppliers
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps governed by ISDA 2002 where non-USD borrowing is converted to USD liabilities
Vanilla currency swaps with no leverage or exotic optionality for long-term trade contracts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foundation Government Fee (Anualidad de Fundación de Interés Privado)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Public Registry of Panama (Registro Público de Panamá) acting with the Ministry of Government
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months following the anniversary of the foundation's inscription in the Public Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Escalating late-payment surcharge of USD 50 up to USD 100; non-payment for four consecutive years transfers the foundation to the Inactive Entities Registry ('tienda cerrada') and triggers administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Business License Renewal (Patente Municipal / Aviso de Operación)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipality of Panama (Municipio de Panamá) – Department of Licenses and Taxes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 January, aligned with the municipal fiscal calendar for warehousing operations in Panama District
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Municipal fines and statutory surcharges on the unpaid patent fee; persistent non-renewal exposes the facility to municipal closure orders and issuance of a delinquency certificate affecting the PIF's tax good-standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Sanitary Operating License Renewal (Licencia Sanitaria de Funcionamiento) for Refrigerated Pharmaceutical Warehouse
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Health (MINSA) – Directorate General of Pharmacy and Drugs (DNFD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the first calendar quarter (1 January – 31 March) or by the renewal date specified in the license resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under the Panamanian Sanitary Law and MINSA regulations; suspension of the sanitary license until reinspection, immediate cessation of cold storage operations, and quarantine of affected pharmaceutical batches.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta – Formulario 102)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the calendar fiscal year-end; for approved special fiscal years, within three months after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines under Tax Code Article 711 (USD 100–500) plus monthly interest of 1% on any tax due; the DGI may offset credits, initiate administrative collection ('cobro coactivo'), and embargo bank accounts and receivables for sustained arrears.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Registry Update (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Beneficial Ownership Registry; Resident Agent as information custodian
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days following the foundation's registration anniversary; additionally within 30 days after any transfer of foundation interests, substitution of beneficiaries, or amendment of the foundation charter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines imposed by the DGI for late or inaccurate filings (up to USD 5,000 per violation under Law 254 of 2021); recidivism may suspend the Resident Agent's license and cause registry strike-off in the public interest.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A mandatory independent audit (dictamen de contador público autorizado) applies when the PIF's annual gross income exceeds USD 1,000,000 (B/.1,000,000), requiring audited financial statements to accompany the annual income tax return; otherwise Private Interest Foundations are not subject to a compulsory public audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (NIIF) as formally endorsed in Panama for larger entities; IFRS for SMEs permitted for non-public-interest PIFs; accounting records must reconcile with the Panamanian Tax Code (Código Fiscal).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The PIF must maintain a confidential beneficial-ownership register identifying the founder, foundation council members, beneficiaries, and any protector. Annually, the Foundation Council issues a sworn confirmation updated through the Resident Agent and filed with the DGI's Beneficial Ownership Registry; any transfer of foundation interests or substitution of beneficiaries requires an updated filing within 30 days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Foundation Council Members (Registro del Consejo de la Fundación)
Register of Beneficiaries and UBO Register (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
Foundation Minute Book (Libro de Actas del Consejo de la Fundación)
Statutory Accounting Books and Supporting Ledgers (Libros de Contabilidad)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – 900 per annum (resident agent, registered office, and corporate compliance support)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – 6,500 per annum for a mid-size refrigerated logistics entity, when audit is triggered by the USD 1,000,000 gross-receipts threshold or lender requirement

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general CIT exemption for cold-storage logistics. Optional preferential regimes: Multinational Company Headquarters (SEM, Law 41 of 2007) effective rate of 5% on Panama-source income; Panama Pacifico Special Economic Zone income tax holiday of up to 100% for 20 years; Ciudad del Saber exemptions. Loss carryforward of 5 years and standard deductions for depreciation of refrigeration equipment, energy, rent, payroll, and insurance are available.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 750 Declaración de Renta (annual corporate income tax return) filed through the DGI e-filing platform (Sistema TAN-B / Declaraciones Electrónicas)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the third month following the fiscal year-end (31 March for calendar-year taxpayers); a two-month extension is available upon justified written request to the DGI before the ordinary deadline

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue derived from refrigerated warehousing, cold-chain logistics, and related storage services physically rendered in Panama
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Panama-source gross revenue; foreign-source revenue of a Private Interest Foundation is territorially exempt and disclosed in the informational annex

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating costs: electricity for temperature-controlled units, warehouse leases, staff payroll, maintenance, insurance, depreciation of cold-storage equipment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support with contemporaneous invoices and contracts retained in Panama; cross-border service payments are deductible only when properly documented and subject to the applicable 12.5% withholding at source

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after deductions and allowable loss carryforwards (maximum 5 years)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-source income must be excluded; foreign losses cannot reduce Panamanian taxable income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory corporate income tax rate applied to Box 3
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No branch remittance tax or additional surtax applies beyond the 25% CIT and the 10% dividend withholding upon distribution

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for withheld taxes, quarterly advance income tax payments (anticipos), and other allowed tax credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned foundations cannot claim foreign tax credits against Panamanian CIT; foreign VAT is not creditable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 (Impuesto por Pagar o Saldo a Favor)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable or refund balance after credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Refunds are processed administratively by the DGI; non-residents must appoint a fiscal agent with power of attorney to request and receive refunds

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 10% surcharge on the tax due plus monthly interest of 1% (any fraction of a month counts as a full month), late-payment surcharge of up to 50%, and fines of B/.100 to B/.5,000 for repeated non-compliance; the DGI may suspend the Certificado de Paz y Salvo, blocking banking transactions and Commercial Registry filings

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 745 Información Anual de Accionistas / Beneficiarios (annual beneficial-ownership and insider information return) via DGI e-filing
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due together with the annual CIT return, on or before the last day of the third month following the fiscal year-end; mandatory even when no taxable income was generated

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: PIF registered name, RUCA taxpayer number, date of incorporation, Commercial Registry folio, resident agent and fiscal representative data
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the foundation council and the Panamanian fiscal representative; foreign directors must be listed with passport and address data

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full beneficial ownership chain: founder, foundation council members, protectors, and beneficiaries with percentage interests and entitlement rights
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficiaries must be fully disclosed; nominee council members must declare their agent capacity and name the principal

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that financial records are maintained in Panama or are accessible to the DGI upon request
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: English-language records are accepted but must be translated into Spanish when formally required by the DGI

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Unfiled or false Form 745: fines from B/.200 to B/.10,000 under Law 8 of 2010, plus the 10% surcharge and 1% monthly interest where tax concealment exists; deliberate omission is investigated as tax fraud under Law 70 of 2019

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Annual Declaration (Declaración Anual de Sustancia Económica) – DGI e-filing annex for entities carrying on relevant activities
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed simultaneously with Form 750, within three months after the end of the fiscal year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare whether the PIF carries on a relevant activity, including distribution and service centre operations encompassing refrigerated warehousing for affiliated parties
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PIF deriving foreign-source income from cold-storage services must demonstrate economic substance in Panama; otherwise it must state the pure-holding classification and reduced filing status

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panama-source and foreign-source gross income, operating expenditure, and assets physically located in Panama
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the source country of each income stream and the place where storage contracts are executed and performed

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that storage operations, inventory management, quality control, customer contracting, and logistics coordination decisions are made in Panama
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foundation council meetings must be physically held in Panama and minuted to evidence CIGA; remote participation must be recorded

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Penalties under Law 254 of 2019 and Executive Decree 163 of 2020: non-filing or false filing from B/.5,000 up to B/.1,000,000 per year, publication of sanctioned entities, cancellation of tax treaty benefits, and referral to the UAF for AML review

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% aggregate final dividend tax on profit distributions derived from Panama-source income, structured as a 5% advance dividend tax payable by the company with Form 750 and a 5% withholding at the time of actual distribution to the beneficiaries
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama maintains a limited DTA network (Mexico, Spain, Netherlands, Barbados, UAE, Qatar, and others). To invoke a reduced dividend rate the beneficial owner must (i) obtain a Certificate of Fiscal Residence (TRC) from the treaty jurisdiction, (ii) deliver it to the Panamanian withholding agent before the distribution date, (iii) submit the DGI treaty-relief application with supporting beneficial-ownership declarations, and (iv) retain the foundation minutes and beneficiary records evidencing entitlement. Without the TRC and DGI validation, the full 10% statutory rate is withheld and recovery requires a DGI refund proceeding
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for IP, trademarks, and technical know-how used in Panama: statutory 12.5% (treaty rates generally 5-10%). Interest paid to foreign related parties on credit used in Panama: statutory 12.5% (treaty rates generally 5-10%). Interest paid to first-class international banks on foreign loans may benefit from a reduced rate subject to bank certification and DGI guidelines

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Balboas (B/.), pegged 1:1 to USD. Local File mandatory when related-party transactions exceed B/.2,000,000 per fiscal year; Master File when consolidated group revenue exceeds B/.200,000,000; Country-by-Country Report when group annual consolidated revenue equals or exceeds B/.750,000,000; a simplified annual related-party return (annex to Form 750) is required when intercompany transactions exceed B/.250,000
